config.title: Laundry in Berlin - FAQ
config.subtitle: Where to wash clothes mid-trip: how a self-service Waschsalon works, what it costs, wash-and-fold services, Sundays and payment.

items.q: How much does laundry cost in Berlin?
items.a: Plan on **about 11 to 12 euro for one full self-service load**: 5.50 to 6 euro for a normal wash at the big chains, about 1.70 euro per 10 minutes of drying, and 0.55 to 0.70 euro for detergent. A 6 kg wash-and-fold service load is **11.90 euro at Freddy Leck** in Moabit, 15.40 euro folded.

items.q: Are laundromats in Berlin open on Sundays?
items.a: Yes. The self-service chains run **seven days a week**, most from **06:00 to 22:00 or 23:00**, and Sunday is one of the quietest times to go. Shops are closed that day, so a Sunday morning wash costs you very little sightseeing time.

items.q: Do Berlin laundromats take card payments?
items.a: Some do, many still run on **coins**. Eco-Express accepts cards at most branches, and Freddy Leck lets you **pay at the counter**. Carry a handful of 1 and 2 euro coins anyway, and note that the **last coin insertion is often 21:00** even when the door closes later.

items.q: Is there a laundry service where someone washes my clothes for me?
items.a: Yes, it is called **Service Light or wash-and-fold**: you drop the bag, staff wash, dry and bag it, and you collect it about **4 to 6 hours later**. At Freddy Leck a 6 kg load is **11.90 euro including detergent**, almost the same as doing it yourself, which is why I recommend it to most visitors.

items.q: How long does a self-service wash take in Berlin?
items.a: Budget **75 to 95 minutes** for one load: about 40 to 50 minutes of washing and 30 minutes of drying. The trick is to plan breakfast, a bakery run or your phone admin around the machine time instead of sitting and staring at the drum.

items.q: Are there laundromats near Alexanderplatz or in central Mitte?
items.a: Central Mitte around Alexanderplatz and Unter den Linden is **thin on self-service laundromats**. The practical move is a short U-Bahn hop: **Eco-Express at Danziger Strasse 7** is about 120 m from U Eberswalder Strasse on the U2, two stops of tram or U-Bahn from the Alexanderplatz area.
